title: Inside out and that was for luck
html_source:
One of the most well known superstitions in connection with underwear is when someone wears their underwear inside out! This has long been considered lucky. There was also the belief that if one was experiencing an unlucky day, the only way to turn it around was to wear underwear inside out!
http://www.auntyflo.com/Superstition-dictionary/underwear
